title_tag: 1000多架无人机扑向俄罗斯，莫斯科遭“史上最大规模”空袭：乌克兰为什么突然打这么狠？—— 英国《金融时报》外刊讲解第1176天
h1: 1000多架无人机扑向俄罗斯，莫斯科遭“史上最大规模”空袭：乌克兰为什么突然打这么狠？
category: 英国《金融时报》外刊讲解 第1176天
nav_hint: Largest ever drone attack on Moscow

headline.en_html: Ukraine hits Moscow with ‘largest ever’ drone attack — Major oil refinery in Russian capital set ablaze as voting draws to a close in stage-managed parliamentary elections
headline.zh: 乌克兰以“史上最大规模”无人机袭击莫斯科 —— 俄罗斯首都一家大型炼油厂被点燃，精心操控的议会选举投票临近尾声

paragraphs.en_html: Ukraine has hit Moscow with what local authorities said was the largest ever drone attack on the capital, setting a major oil <mark class="voc">refinery</mark> <mark class="voc">ablaze</mark> and killing at least two people, as voting in Russia’s <mark class="voc">stage-managed</mark> <mark class="voc">parliamentary</mark> elections entered its final day.
paragraphs.zh: 乌克兰对莫斯科发动了地方当局所称的迄今为止针对首都的最大规模无人机袭击，一座大型炼油厂燃起大火，至少两人丧生。与此同时，俄罗斯精心操控的议会选举投票进入最后一天。

notes.en: a factory where a raw material such as oil or sugar is purified or processed
notes.ctx: 指莫斯科南部的一家大型石油加工厂，遭无人机袭击后起火。
notes.ex1: The refinery on the outskirts of the city processes over 200,000 barrels of crude oil per day. 该市郊区的炼油厂每天加工超过20万桶原油。
notes.ex2: Residents complained about the pollution emitted by the local sugar refinery. 居民抱怨当地糖厂排放的污染物。

notes.en: burning strongly and brightly
notes.ctx: 指炼油厂被无人机击中后猛烈燃烧，燃起大火。
notes.ex1: By the time firefighters arrived, the entire warehouse was ablaze. 消防员赶到时，整座仓库已是一片火海。
notes.ex2: The forest was set ablaze by lightning during the dry summer. 干旱的夏季里，闪电引发了森林大火。

notes.en: organized and controlled in order to produce a particular result or impression, often in a deceptive way
notes.zh: 精心安排的，幕后操控的
notes.ctx: 指俄罗斯议会选举实为克里姆林宫幕后操纵，缺乏真正的竞争与公正。
notes.ex1: The protest was widely seen as a stage-managed event designed to show public support for the regime. 这场抗议被普遍视为一场精心安排的表演，旨在展示公众对政权的支持。
notes.ex2: Critics argued that the trial was stage-managed from start to finish, with the verdict decided in advance. 批评者认为这场审判从头到尾都是幕后操控，判决早已内定。

notes.en: relating to a parliament, the body of elected representatives that makes laws
notes.ctx: 指俄罗斯举行的议会选举投票。
notes.ex1: The parliamentary debate on healthcare reform lasted well into the night. 关于医疗改革的议会辩论一直持续到深夜。
notes.ex2: She spent a decade as a parliamentary aide before running for office herself. 她在自己竞选公职之前，担任了十年的议会助理。

paragraphs.en_html: Moscow’s <mark class="voc">mayor</mark> Sergei Sobyanin said air defences shot down 450 drones as they approached the capital on Saturday night, calling the attack “<mark class="voc">unprecedented</mark>”. Sobyanin claimed the attack was “clearly planned to <mark class="voc">disrupt</mark> the elections”, adding that “the enemy did not succeed”. Several drones hit the Moscow Refinery in the south of the capital, one of Russia’s largest.
paragraphs.zh: 莫斯科市长谢尔盖·索比亚宁表示，周六夜间，防空系统在无人机逼近首都时击落了450架，并称此次袭击“前所未有”。索比亚宁声称，袭击“显然意在扰乱选举”，并补充说“敌人没有得逞”。数架无人机击中了位于莫斯科南部的莫斯科炼油厂，该厂是俄罗斯最大的炼油厂之一。

notes.en: the elected head of a city or town government
notes.ctx: 指莫斯科市长谢尔盖·索比亚宁，他就袭击事件发表声明。
notes.ex1: The mayor announced a new initiative to expand public transportation across the city. 市长宣布了一项在全市扩展公共交通的新计划。
notes.ex2: The mayor of the small coastal town personally welcomed the visiting delegation. 这座海滨小城的市长亲自迎接了来访代表团。

notes.en: never having happened or existed before
notes.zh: 前所未有的，史无前例的
notes.ctx: 指此次无人机袭击莫斯科的规模为历史之最。
notes.ex1: The pandemic caused an unprecedented disruption to global supply chains. 疫情对全球供应链造成了前所未有的冲击。
notes.ex2: The company reported an unprecedented surge in online sales during the holiday season. 该公司报告称，假日季线上销售额出现了前所未有的激增。

notes.en: to interrupt the normal course or unity of something
notes.ctx: 索比亚宁声称袭击意在扰乱选举进程。
notes.ex1: Heavy snowfall disrupted flights across the region for two consecutive days. 大雪连续两天扰乱了该地区的航班。
notes.ex2: The strike threatened to disrupt food deliveries to hospitals and schools. 罢工可能扰乱医院和学校的食品配送。

paragraphs.en_html: Videos on social media showed a drone exploding into the refinery, with <mark class="voc">plumes of</mark> black smoke <mark class="voc">shrouding</mark> the sunrise, and several areas of the facility on fire. A nearby power station, <mark class="voc">warehouse</mark> and market were also hit. Drones also hit residential buildings near the refinery and at least 11 <mark class="voc">suburban</mark> towns in the surrounding region, authorities said. Two people died in the attacks and a further 20 people were injured, including three children, according to Andrei Vorobyov, <mark class="voc">governor</mark> of the Moscow region.
paragraphs.zh: 社交媒体上的视频显示，一架无人机在炼油厂爆炸，滚滚黑烟遮蔽了日出，厂区多处起火。附近的一座发电站、仓库和集市也遭到袭击。当局称，无人机还击中了炼油厂附近的居民楼以及周边地区至少11个郊区城镇。据莫斯科州州长安德烈·沃罗比约夫称，袭击造成两人死亡，另有20人受伤，其中包括三名儿童。

notes.en: a tall, thin column of smoke, dust, or other substance rising into the air
notes.zh: 一缕，一股（升腾的烟、尘等）
notes.ctx: 描述炼油厂遇袭后滚滚黑烟升腾、遮蔽日出的景象。
notes.ex1: A plume of smoke rose from the chimney and drifted across the valley. 一缕炊烟从烟囱升起，飘过山谷。
notes.ex2: After the explosion, a massive plume of dust and debris shot into the sky. 爆炸发生后，一大股尘土和碎片直冲云霄。

notes.en: to cover or conceal something, especially with a dark or thick layer
notes.ctx: 黑烟笼罩了日出，形容浓烟之厚重。
notes.ex1: Thick fog shrouded the entire harbor, forcing ferries to remain docked. 浓雾笼罩了整个港口，渡轮被迫停航。
notes.ex2: The mountain peak was shrouded in mist for most of the morning. 整个上午山峰都笼罩在薄雾之中。

notes.en: a large building used for storing goods
notes.ctx: 指炼油厂附近遭无人机袭击的仓储设施。
notes.ex1: The company leased a warehouse near the port to store imported goods. 该公司在港口附近租了一间仓库来存放进口货物。
notes.ex2: Firefighters battled the blaze for hours before bringing the warehouse fire under control. 消防员与大火搏斗了数小时才将仓库火势控制住。

notes.en: relating to or characteristic of a suburb, a residential area on the edge of a city
notes.ctx: 指莫斯科周边至少11个郊区城镇也遭到无人机袭击。
notes.ex1: They moved from the city center to a quiet suburban neighborhood after their first child was born. 第一个孩子出生后，他们从市中心搬到了安静的郊区社区。
notes.ex2: Suburban commuters rely heavily on trains to get to work downtown. 郊区通勤者严重依赖火车前往市中心上班。

notes.en: the official who governs a state, province, or region
notes.ctx: 指莫斯科州州长沃罗比约夫，他公布了伤亡情况。
notes.ex1: The governor declared a state of emergency after the hurricane made landfall. 飓风登陆后，州长宣布进入紧急状态。
notes.ex2: The governor signed a bill raising the minimum wage across the state. 州长签署了一项在全州范围内提高最低工资的法案。

paragraphs.en_html: The <mark class="voc">consequences</mark> of the Moscow attack extended beyond the <mark class="voc">initial</mark> fires. Russia’s Moscow refinery <mark class="voc">halted</mark> <mark class="voc">crude</mark> processing after both of its main crude <mark class="voc">distillation</mark> units were damaged, according to industry sources. One <mark class="voc">accounts for</mark> 53 per cent of the refinery’s capacity and the other for the remaining 47 per cent. Repairs could take several weeks. The plant processed 11.6mn tonnes of crude in 2024 and produced 2.9mn tonnes of gasoline and 3.2mn tonnes of diesel.
paragraphs.zh: 莫斯科袭击的后果远不止最初的火情。据行业消息人士称，俄罗斯莫斯科炼油厂在两套主要原油蒸馏装置均受损后已停止原油加工。其中一套占该炼油厂产能的53%，另一套占剩余的47%。维修可能需要数周时间。该厂2024年加工原油1160万吨，生产汽油290万吨、柴油320万吨。

notes.en: a result or effect of an action or condition, especially an important or unwanted one
notes.ctx: 指莫斯科遇袭的影响远不止最初的火情，还波及炼油厂运营。
notes.ex1: The consequences of the decision to cut funding for education will be felt for generations. 削减教育经费这一决定的后果将影响几代人。
notes.ex2: He was fully aware of the consequences of breaking the contract. 他完全清楚违反合同的后果。

notes.en: happening at the beginning; first
notes.ctx: 指袭击造成的后果不仅限于最初的火情。
notes.ex1: Despite initial setbacks, the team eventually completed the project on time. 尽管最初遭遇挫折，团队最终还是按时完成了项目。
notes.ex2: The initial response to the product launch was overwhelmingly positive. 产品发布后的初步反响极为积极。

notes.en: to stop; to bring or come to a sudden stop
notes.ctx: 指炼油厂在装置受损后停止原油加工。
notes.ex1: Production was halted for three hours due to a power outage. 由于停电，生产中断了三个小时。
notes.ex2: The government halted the construction of the dam pending an environmental review. 政府暂停了大坝建设，等待环境评估。

notes.en: unrefined petroleum; oil in its natural state before being processed
notes.ctx: 指炼油厂加工的未精炼石油。
notes.ex1: Global crude prices fell sharply after the OPEC meeting. 欧佩克会议后，全球原油价格大幅下跌。
notes.ex2: The country exports millions of barrels of crude every month. 该国每月出口数百万桶原油。

notes.en: the process of purifying a liquid by heating it until it becomes a gas and then cooling it back into liquid form
notes.ctx: 指炼油厂的原油蒸馏装置，是炼油的核心工艺。
notes.ex1: The distillation process separates crude oil into different products such as gasoline and diesel. 蒸馏过程将原油分离为汽油和柴油等不同产品。
notes.ex2: The laboratory uses fractional distillation to isolate the individual components of the mixture. 实验室采用分馏法分离混合物中的各单一成分。

notes.en: to form or make up a particular amount or proportion of something
notes.ctx: 指一套蒸馏装置占炼油厂产能的53%。
notes.ex1: Renewable energy sources now account for nearly 30 per cent of the country's electricity generation. 可再生能源目前占全国发电量的近30%。
notes.ex2: Online sales account for more than half of the retailer's total revenue. 线上销售占该零售商总营收的一半以上。

paragraphs.en_html: Flights were <mark class="voc">grounded</mark> at all three of Moscow’s main airports. Russia’s defence ministry claimed to have shot down a total of 1,110 drones across the country overnight. Kyiv and Moscow have continued <mark class="voc">striking</mark> each other’s energy infrastructure throughout the week despite Donald Trump’s claim on Monday that the <mark class="voc">warring</mark> sides had agreed to halt such attacks, which the US president <mark class="voc">blamed</mark> for the surge in global diesel prices. Trump has not commented on the attacks, which Russia and Ukraine continued within hours of his statement.
paragraphs.zh: 莫斯科三大主要机场的航班全部停飞。俄罗斯国防部声称，一夜之间在全国范围内共击落1110架无人机。尽管唐纳德·特朗普周一声称交战双方已同意停止此类袭击——这位美国总统将全球柴油价格飙升归咎于这些袭击——基辅和莫斯科本周仍持续打击彼此的能源基础设施。特朗普尚未对这些袭击置评，而俄罗斯和乌克兰在他发表声明后数小时内便继续发动了袭击。

notes.en: to prevent an aircraft or pilot from flying
notes.ctx: 指莫斯科三大机场的航班全部停飞。
notes.ex1: All flights were grounded due to the volcanic ash cloud spreading across Europe. 由于火山灰云蔓延欧洲，所有航班停飞。
notes.ex2: The airline grounded its entire fleet of that model pending safety inspections. 该航空公司在安全检查期间停飞了该型号的全部机队。

notes.en: to attack someone or something suddenly and violently
notes.ctx: 指俄乌双方持续打击彼此的能源基础设施。
notes.ex1: The rebels struck the military base at dawn, catching the soldiers off guard. 叛军在黎明时分袭击了军事基地，士兵们措手不及。
notes.ex2: The enemy struck deep into civilian territory, targeting power stations and water supplies. 敌军深入平民地区发动打击，目标直指发电站和供水设施。

notes.en: involved in a war or conflict; fighting against each other
notes.ctx: 指特朗普称交战双方已同意停止此类袭击。
notes.ex1: The warring factions finally agreed to a fragile peace deal after months of negotiation. 交战各派经过数月谈判，终于达成了一项脆弱的和平协议。
notes.ex2: Aid agencies struggled to deliver supplies to civilians trapped between the warring armies. 援助机构难以向被困在交战军队之间的平民运送物资。

notes.en: to hold someone or something responsible for a fault or wrong
notes.ctx: 特朗普将全球柴油价格飙升归咎于此类袭击。
notes.ex1: The manager blamed the delay on poor communication between departments. 经理将延误归咎于部门之间沟通不畅。
notes.ex2: Consumers blamed the company for the faulty software that compromised their data. 消费者指责该公司应为导致其数据泄露的软件缺陷负责。
